comments.body: Reopening — the same trace showed up again this morning.

content.text: Reopening — the same trace showed up again this morning.
Steps to reproduce: open export never finishes with a workspace that has more than one member.
Expected: the view keeps the selected filters after a reload.
Actual: filters reset to the default and the row count changes.
Impact: reported by two customers this week; no data loss observed.
